It's all in the genes!

Deacon Phillippe is carving his own lane in the entertainment industry after learning from his superstar parents, Ryan Phillippe and Reese Witherspoon. The handsome actor is starring in new fashion campaigns, picking up some acting credits, and putting out his own music.

The 22-year-old star made his acting debut as Parker in the third season of the Netflix series Never Have I Ever and even made a guest appearance in the Prime Video series Motorheads alongside his father. Besides acting, Phillippe has invested a lot of time into music. He's released electronic and dance songs under the mononym Deacon. He also has credits as an electronic music producer, songwriter, and DJ.

Now, photos of the father-son duo are lighting up social media. The two flex their rock-hard abs at a gorgeous destination in the woods nearby a creek. Both stars aren't afraid to show skin on social media, as Ryan posted a sweaty sauna selfie that went viral earlier this year and Deacon posed in a shirtless photo shoot just last month.

Check out the viral photos below! Fans can also Deacon Phillippe on Instagram here.

Gillian Anderson Shares That She Is Pansexual

This story originally appeared on Them.

Gillian Anderson being part of the LGBTQ+ community is not a revelation. As long ago as 2012, the X-Files star told Out magazine that she was once in relationships with other women, and has spoken intermittently about feeling sexually fluid since then. But in a new interview with The Australian, Anderson seems to be landing on a label: pansexual.

In the profile, writer Nikki Gemmell writes that Anderson “tells me she’s pan, as in pansexual, as in attracted to all genders; from the Greek derivation meaning ‘all’ or ‘every,’ adding that the actress said, “in my younger years I was in relationships with women.”
